actions.create_highlight.description: Save a new highlight to Readwise.
actions.create_highlight.props.highlight: A unique URL that links directly to this highlight.
Date when the highlight was made (defaults to now).
Position of the highlight in the source.
actions.create_highlight.props.location_: How the location above is measured.
actions.create_highlight.props.note.desc: Optional note to attach to the highlight.
actions.create_highlight.props.source_ty: An identifier for your app/source, e.g. "my_app" (3–64 chars, no spaces).
actions.create_highlight.props.source_ur: URL of the article or webpage.
actions.create_highlight.props.text.desc: The text you want to save as a highlight.
actions.create_highlight.props.title.des: Title of the book, article, or source.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_highlights.description: Retrieve your Readwise highlights, optionally filtered by book or date.
actions.get_highlights.props.book_id.des: The book or article to filter highlights by.
actions.get_highlights.props.page.descri: Which page of results to return (starts at 1).
actions.get_highlights.props.page_size.d: Number of highlights to return per page (max 1000).
actions.get_highlights.props.updated_aft: Return only highlights updated after this date.
auth.description: Your Readwise access token. Get it at https://readwise.io/access_token
description: Save and retrieve your highlights from Readwise — your reading notes, all in one place.
triggers.new_highlight.description: Fires when a new highlight is saved to Readwise.
